title: Market Quote Bridge Payload
description: Payload emitted by python/src/market/fetcher.py and consumed by app/lib/market/quote-bridge.ts. One request carries many symbols because the bridge's cost is almost entirely interpreter startup (~1.9s) and the marginal cost per symbol is near zero; see app/lib/market/quote-bridge.ts.

quotes.description: One entry per symbol the caller asked for, in the order asked. A symbol that could not be priced appears with price null and a reason — it is never omitted, because a caller matching by position must be able to tell 'not asked' from 'asked and unavailable'.

symbol.description: Echo of the requested symbol, uppercased. Never a symbol the bridge substituted.

price.description: Last observed price. null means no live source could price it. The bridge never estimates, derives or carries forward a value into this field.

previousClose.description: Previous official close when the feed supplies one. null means 'we do not know' and must stay null — a day change derived from a guessed close is fabricated. Mirrors QuoteSnapshot.previousClose in app/lib/market/quote.ts.

currency.description: ISO code as reported by the feed. null when the feed did not say; the caller must not infer one from the ticker suffix and then present it as observed.

asOf.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the reading as reported by the feed, not the time the bridge ran. null when the feed supplied no timestamp.

source.description: Which feed answered. 'none' accompanies a null price. There is deliberately no synthetic value here — the bridge has no placeholder mode, so MARKET_MOCK_FALLBACK_MODE has nothing to permit on this path.

reason.description: Present when price is null: why the reading could not be taken. Diagnostic only, never rendered as a value.

resolved.description: How many of the requested symbols got a price. requested minus resolved is the gap the caller must render as unavailable rather than fill.
